subject.title: fix(daemon): refuse duplicate launchd gateway managers

question: Should OpenClaw merge this narrow fail-closed same-label system LaunchDaemon guard now, or wait for the broader macOS LaunchDaemon lifecycle contract?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix, but it deliberately changes existing operator workflows with stale or externally managed system plists from proceeding to stopping with recovery guidance.

options.title: Accept the narrow guard
options.body: Merge this PR as the focused fix for the duplicate-manager restart-storm bug while tracking full LaunchDaemon lifecycle separately.

options.title: Broaden before merge
options.body: Pause until install, status, restart, stop, uninstall, doctor, docs, and privileged UX share one system/user launchd scope contract.

options.title: Prefer the sibling candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97296 only if maintainers decide that branch is the safer canonical landing path after proof and review refresh.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow guard
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the focused fix for the duplicate-manager restart-storm bug while tracking full LaunchDaemon lifecycle separately.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned on the live PR and authored the latest head commit touching the launchd conflict guard.
